audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The local-system dual has the wrong shift for Lemma 3.27; The reordering cylinder has incompatible dimensions; The translation construction is not a strict Q-cocycle
limitations: P1 — The local-system dual has the wrong shift for Lemma 3.27 — Counterevidence: The zero section already has tube generation and satisfies the geometric conclusions; it is a counterexample to the printed derived normalization, not to the main theorem. The delta-action sign correction is explicitly granted.

P2 — The reordering cylinder has incompatible dimensions — Counterevidence: The preceding formulas for reordered functions and their cocycles do pass; they still generate the same immersion. The nearby-Lagrangian existence argument can use these functions and recover the twisting class by projection equivalence and Gauss factorization.

P3 — The translation construction is not a strict Q-cocycle — Counterevidence: The conclusion is not disproved. Core factorization only needs the inclusion map, not its equivalence. Freely selected auxiliary dimensions can be even; the explicit shift in Theorem 3.9 is 2m. Even translations in the full stabilized model follow from left h action and Theorem 2.21, bypassing the bad full +1 argument.
P4 — The refinement cylinder order can contain a cycle — Counterevidence: All actual local MV data remain valid; no local cocycle or resulting homotopy class changes under the repair.

P5 — The unrestricted lifting statement needs proper critical data — Counterevidence: Section 3's closed-L motivation and the actual linear-at-infinity application exclude this nonproper example. That application has proper critical data over the compact isotopy support.
Limitations: The assigned arXiv v3 was reviewed; publisher body was inaccessible and no journal-text equivalence or absence of later corrections is certified.
Limitations: Reading all manuscript text and checking these proof chains is not exhaustive proof certification.

Limitations: The full imported Floer/sheaf proof of projection homotopy equivalence, complete Bökstedt proof and Waldhausen tube comparison, Adams J detection, and all function-space/direct-limit foundations were not independently reconstructed.
Limitations: General repair of the Lemma 3.7 cylinder and the full Lemma 2.23 translation proof remains outstanding.
Limitations: Author adoption was not observed; this is initial review, not independent acceptance or human review.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.

repair.content:
Use H[d] directly. For each finite field pass to a finite cover orienting the base and negative bundle and killing finitely many finite monodromy groups. Thom plus L~M yields RΓ(H[d])~RΓk_M. Lemma 3.27 then gives H[d]=k_M; finite-generation and tensor-product lemmas yield integral rank-one fiber homology.

Retain in J only comparisons supported by nonempty overlaps, take their transitive closure, then form and close the mixed relation. σ is now globally monotone. Every crossing cycle would include a strict increase in I, hence cannot occur. Local orders, nonempty MV simplices, endpoint maps and cocycles remain identical.
